nodes.label: 200-Line File Size Limit Rule
nodes.rationale: Files capped at 200 lines (further split by category) to prevent performance-heavy 'monster' files and keep components modular for load-time and maintainability.

nodes.label: Lazy Loading / Code Splitting Guideline
nodes.rationale: Prioritize lazy loading and code splitting to reduce initial bundle size and GPU usage while preserving visual fidelity.
